business_definition: Active employees on the last day of the month (permanent and contract).
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) with hire_date <= month_end AND (exit_date IS NULL OR exit_date > month_end)
caveat: Excludes CEO if you compare departments only

business_definition: Employees whose hire_date falls in the month.
Employees whose exit_date falls in the month (resigned, terminated or contract ended).
Share of people who left in the month.
Leavers in the last 12 months divided by average headcount over the same months.
caveat: Use for headline reporting; monthly is too noisy

business_definition: Same as M05 but only resignations (voluntary_exits).
Total earnings before deductions for the month.
Take-home pay after employee deductions.
Full cost of employees to the company: gross pay plus employer PF and ESI.
good_direction: Lower is better when output is equal

business_definition: Average employer cost per paid employee.
How much of payroll cost is overtime pay.
Bonus, incentive and award pay as a share of gross pay.
caveat: April bonus and quarter-end incentives create spikes

business_definition: Days present (half day counts 0.5) divided by scheduled working days.
caveat: Paid leave counts as not present

business_definition: Late check-ins per present day.
caveat: Work-from-home days use web check-in time

business_definition: Unpaid absence and unpaid leave days.
Income booked in the ledger (accounts 4001-4004).
Revenue minus all expenses (4xxx less 5xxx).
Net profit as a share of revenue.
Share of revenue consumed by payroll cost.
caveat: Use ledger payroll accounts to avoid mismatch

business_definition: Average days to collect: receivables divided by credit sales x days.
formula: Closing receivables / revenue incl GST (last 90 days) x 90

business_definition: Unpaid invoice balance past due date at the report date.
formula: SUM(balance_due) where due_date < report date and status not DRAFT/CANCELLED

business_definition: Tasks done divided by tasks planned in the sprint (cancelled tasks excluded).
caveat: Sample feed until the live board is ready

business_definition: Done tasks completed on or before the sprint end date.
Story points completed in the sprint.
Days from start to completion for done tasks.
Share of scored records flagged by the AI anomaly service.
Share of employees in the High attrition-risk band.
caveat: Show by group only; never rank named people

business_definition: Average absolute percentage error of headcount forecasts versus actuals.
caveat: Needs actuals for the forecast months
